'''P-T48''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war it ran a stall within the Republic controlled [[Shipwright Auxiliary Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. P-T48 had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] and gold plating.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
P-T48 first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' which was released in [[2011]] by [[BioWare]]. In the game it serves as a Republic social items vendor on Corellia. Its location was also marked on a map in the accompanying [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide|strategy guide]].
